baseline_models.focus_anchor: The imperative ٱذْهَبْ with إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ directs motion toward a named endpoint, while إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ supplies its reason.
baseline_models.mechanism: The going-and-passing branch of ذ ه ب couples commanded movement to the limit-crossing branch of ط غ ي: motion is sent precisely toward the place where a boundary has been exceeded.

activation_trace.role: Going and passing supplies the literal directed motion and makes it the operative response.
Exceeding a limit in disobedience supplies the breached boundary that gives the motion its destination and reason.

changed_reading.before: A bare order to visit Pharaoh because he behaved badly.
changed_reading.after: A commissioned movement aimed at the concrete site of a breached limit.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: طَغَىٰ predicates the root directly of Pharaoh, while ٱذْهَبْ sends the addressee into relation with him.
baseline_models.mechanism: The rising-water and sweeping-force branch, joined to the overbearing-ruler branch, lets Pharaoh's excess behave as propagated coercive pressure rather than as a private moral quantity.

activation_trace.role: Rising water and sweeping force supplies an image of excess that spreads beyond its source.
The overbearing tyrant locates that propagated excess in the named ruler.
Going places the commissioned actor within range of the sweeping force rather than observing it remotely.

changed_reading.before: Pharaoh possesses an unusually large amount of disobedience.
changed_reading.after: Pharaoh is the center of an overreaching coercive force, and the command sends an agent into its field.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction ٱذْهَبْ إِلَىٰ fixes a route and endpoint, and طَغَىٰ characterizes that endpoint.
baseline_models.mechanism: The route-or-method branch of ذ ه ب and the head-of-misguidance branch of ط غ ي create a routing conflict: an authorized way is carried toward a center that diverts from a good way.

activation_trace.role: A route, place, or method supplies the authorized way carried by the imperative.
A head of misguidance supplies the rival center that redirects others from a good route.

changed_reading.after: Carry an authorized route toward a center of misrouting.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening advances from forceful withdrawal through release and traversal, wide motion, and precedence into management of an affair. This sequence recruits the focus imperative as a downstream instance of ordered, outcome-aware motion rather than an isolated journey.

activation_trace.role: Going and passing anchors the opening kinetic sequence back in the focus imperative.
An impulsion of running or travel supplies the forceful launch of the motion chain.
Leaving and moving from place to place contributes released traversal.
Running or swimming contributes sustained motion through a medium.
Advancing and racing gives the sequence ordered precedence.
Managing an affair with regard to its outcome converts speed into governed execution.
Request and obligation supplies the commanding frame that the focus imperative instantiates.

structural_cues: 79:1-5 forms an ordered participial sequence with repeated cognate accusatives, and the two fa-connectors carry it into precedence and management.
The sequence closes with managing an affair before 79:17 presents a direct imperative.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a sequential motion-to-management chain; I infer that the later imperative instantiates its governed kinetics. The live alternative is that the opening only establishes cosmic tempo and does not characterize Moses's commission.

changed_reading.before: A single person is told to make a discrete trip.
changed_reading.after: Moses's going becomes one commissioned link in a wider progression of released motion, precedence, and managed command.

context_deltas.mechanism: The imperative continues a raised call issued by Moses's Lord in a purified place. Its motion is therefore delegated speech and authority moving from true lordship toward an overbearing ruler, not a self-authored expedition.

activation_trace.role: Going carries the preceding call from its source toward its named destination.
The overbearing-ruler image marks the destination as a rival locus of asserted authority.
A raised call supplies the audible source from which the imperative proceeds.
Lordship, ownership, and sovereignty identify the authority behind the journey.
A purified place marks the command's source as ordered and set apart from the destination's excess.

structural_cues: 79:16 places the caller, the possessive ربه, and the sacred valley immediately before the imperative of 79:17.
The command's source and destination are asymmetric: his Lord calls, and Moses goes to Pharaoh.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the call, its sovereign source, and its purified setting; I infer that the imperative relays that authority into Pharaoh's sphere. Alternatively, 79:16 may function only as narrative setting without coloring the journey's mechanism.

changed_reading.before: An imperative launches a self-standing mission toward Pharaoh.
changed_reading.after: The going is a relay: a call from true lordship is carried into the sphere of coercive counterfeit authority.

context_deltas.mechanism: Moses goes toward the limit-breaker in order to offer that person another direction: purification, gentle guidance toward his Lord, and awe. The destination of Moses's motion becomes the possible starting point of Pharaoh's return route.

activation_trace.role: A route or method anchors the focus journey as the carrier of an offered counter-route.
Limit-crossing supplies the condition from which the offered route would turn Pharaoh.
Purity and rectitude supplies the first possible destination of the counter-route.
Gentle indication toward a path or truth supplies the manner of redirection.
Repair, cultivation, and completion make the Lordward direction restorative rather than merely spatial.
Fear joined with reverence supplies the intended internal result of the offered direction.

structural_cues: The two clauses align ٱذْهَبْ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ with وَأَهْدِيَكَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ: Moses moves toward Pharaoh so Pharaoh can be offered another إلى.
79:18 opens with a question rather than a coercive formula, and 79:19 ends with a fa-marked result.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an invitation, purification, gentle direction, and a stated result; I infer that these are the immediate restorative purpose of going. A live alternative is that they are only a demand before judgment and do not characterize the mission more broadly.

changed_reading.before: Go toward the limit-breaker in order to confront him.
changed_reading.after: Go toward him so that the endpoint of Moses's journey may become the beginning of Pharaoh's offered route toward purification, cultivated completion, and awe.

context_deltas.mechanism: A visible sign is shown, then met by denial and disobedience, followed by turning back and purposeful striving. The focus predicate is thereby enacted as counter-motion: Moses goes under command, while Pharaoh turns away and exerts directed effort.

activation_trace.role: Going supplies the obedient trajectory against which Pharaoh's reverse trajectory is read.
Limit-crossing anchors the later sequence as an enactment of the focus predicate.
Showing and making visible supplies disclosure before Pharaoh's counter-movement.
A manifest sign identifies what was disclosed rather than leaving the refusal contentless.
Attributing something to falsehood supplies Pharaoh's epistemic refusal after disclosure.
Departure from obedience turns refusal into a volitional stance.
Turning one's back and withdrawing gives the refusal a reverse direction.
Purposeful motion toward an objective shows that the reverse direction remains active and goal-seeking.

structural_cues: 79:20-22 orders disclosure, denial and disobedience, then backward turning and striving through fa- and thumma-linked verbs.
The forward imperative of 79:17 and the backward verb of 79:22 create a directional antithesis.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered actions; I infer that the disclosed sign occasions a chosen counter-trajectory and that the later verbs unpack طغى. The alternative is a merely chronological list in which the actions need not define the focus predicate.

changed_reading.before: طغى is a static moral label already true before Moses arrives.
changed_reading.after: طغى becomes a deliberately maintained trajectory: refusal after disclosure, withdrawal from the offered route, and purposeful motion in the opposite direction.

context_deltas.mechanism: Pharaoh gathers, raises a call, and utters a highest-lord claim. His excess expands from one person's boundary crossing into a social routing apparatus that assembles bodies and speech around counterfeit sovereignty.

activation_trace.role: A head of misguidance anchors the later gathering and proclamation as organized redirection.
Driving and gathering a group toward a destination supplies the social concentration of Pharaoh's excess.
A raised public call supplies the broadcast channel of the counter-order.
A speaker whose word carries force supplies the claim's attempted social efficacy.
Lordship and sovereignty identify the office Pharaoh publicly appropriates.
Greatness joined to overbearing pride supplies the vertical claim that crowns the counter-order.

structural_cues: 79:23 compresses gathering and calling into two fa-linked verbs, then 79:24 gives the first-person claim addressed to a plural audience.
The possessive contrast between ربه in 79:16 and ربكم in 79:24 places two claims of lordship around the journey.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gathering, public calling, and a sovereignty claim; I infer a social system that routes others around Pharaoh. The alternative is a one-time boast whose audience does not make طغى structurally social.

changed_reading.before: Moses is sent to an individually disobedient king.
changed_reading.after: Moses is sent to the organizing center of a public counter-order that gathers others under a misclaimed highest lordship.

context_deltas.mechanism: Taking arrests the sweeping model of excess; exemplary punishment converts seizure into deterrence, and taking a lesson carries one case across to another fear-capable hearer. The mission begins a process that turns unbounded coercion into a bounded, portable warning.

activation_trace.role: Sweeping overflow supplies the force that the later seizure and deterrent arrest.
Seizure and capture supplies the decisive containment of the overreaching ruler.
A punishment that deters others converts containment into a social warning.
Making one condition a lesson for another carries the case beyond Pharaoh.
Reverential fear identifies the disposition capable of receiving the transferred warning.

structural_cues: 79:25 pairs the latter and the former within the seizure, enlarging its temporal reach.
79:26 immediately recasts the preceding case as an عبرة for an indefinite recipient.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies seizure, deterrent punishment, transferable lesson, and receptive fear; I infer that the focus mission is the opening movement in that containment-to-warning process. Alternatively, the outcome may exemplify the story without retroactively defining the imperative.

changed_reading.before: The imperative initiates a confrontation with a sweeping tyrant.
changed_reading.after: The imperative initiates a process that bounds the overflow and makes its bounded case travel outward as deterrent and lesson.

context_deltas.mechanism: Pharaoh's claim to highestness is followed by a built sky that is raised and made proportionate, water brought forth, mountains anchored, and provision shared. The focus excess becomes elevation or flow detached from proportion, anchorage, and benefit, not magnitude as such.

activation_trace.role: Water rising beyond measure supplies the focus image of ungoverned increase.
Overbearing greatness supplies Pharaoh's self-claimed form of height.
Actual raising supplies a height that belongs within constructed order.
Straightness and completion supplies the proportion governing that height.
The appearing and abundance of water supplies flow that remains integrated with provision.
Fixity and rootedness supplies the anchoring counterpart to rising and flowing forces.
Benefit that is enjoyed supplies the outward purpose of ordered magnitude.

structural_cues: After Pharaoh's ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ claim, 79:27 pivots by asking about harder creation and 79:28-33 unfolds raised, leveled, watered, anchored, beneficial order.
The creation sequence coordinates vertical height, horizontal provision, and stabilization.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies self-claimed height and a subsequent measured creation sequence; I supply the contrast that the latter diagnoses the former as ungoverned magnitude. The live alternative is that 79:27-33 proves resurrection without refining the semantics of طغى.

changed_reading.before: طغى means simply becoming too high or too much.
changed_reading.after: طغى is magnitude severed from measure, anchorage, and shared benefit; height and abundance themselves can belong to rightly ordered creation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact focus predicate reappears with generic من and is specified by preferring the lower life; its countertype fears standing before the Lord and restrains the self from inclination. Pharaoh becomes a named instance of a repeatable preference-and-restraint pattern.

activation_trace.role: Limit-crossing anchors the generic later pattern back in the predicate applied to Pharaoh.
Preferring something by choice supplies the positive selection that sustains transgression.
The lower or nearer life supplies the horizon selected by that preference.
Fear in anticipation of harm supplies the countertype's future-facing check.
Prohibition and restraint supplies the active boundary absent from the limit-crossing pattern.
The living self identifies the internal object that must be governed.
The self's inclination supplies the internal vector from which restraint redirects it.

structural_cues: 79:37 repeats طغى exactly but replaces named Pharaoh with the generic construction من طغى.
79:38 supplies the preference clause, while 79:40 supplies an antithetical pair of fear and self-restraint.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact repetition, genericization, preference, and an explicit countertype; I infer that these clauses diagnose the focus predicate's repeatable inner mechanism. Alternatively, they may generalize only Pharaoh's outcome without fully explaining his prior state.

changed_reading.before: Pharaoh is an exceptional royal transgressor whom Moses alone must approach.
changed_reading.after: Pharaoh is the named instance of a general pattern: choosing the nearer horizon while leaving inclination unrestrained; the mission addresses that human pattern in royal form.

context_deltas.mechanism: Questions about the Hour's anchoring are redirected to the Lord as endpoint, while the messenger is restricted to warning the fear-capable hearer. Going is therefore responsibility for encounter and warning, not jurisdiction over outcome or ultimate timing.

activation_trace.role: Going anchors the bounded role in a required action that can be completed without controlling its result.
Questioning and requesting supplies the demand whose scope is then limited.
A ship's stopping and anchorage supplies the requested fixing point of the Hour.
A reminder supplies the messenger's relevant relation to the event instead of control over its anchoring.
Lordship and sovereignty reserve the event's final determination to its proper authority.
The limit at which something ends supplies the ultimate endpoint outside the messenger's control.
A warning that awakens caution positively defines the messenger's bounded task.
Reverential fear identifies reception rather than coercion as the warning's effective condition.

structural_cues: The phrase إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ مُنتَهَىٰهَا echoes the focus construction ٱذْهَبْ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ while relocating ultimacy to the Lord.
79:45 uses the restrictive إنما to define the messenger as a warner and gives a receptive class rather than a guaranteed result.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a refused timing-demand, the Lordward endpoint, and a restrictive warning role; I infer that the earlier imperative obliges faithful approach rather than successful control of Pharaoh. The alternative is that the closing role limitation applies only to eschatological questioning.

changed_reading.before: Go to Pharaoh in order to secure his change or master the confrontation's result.
changed_reading.after: Go because encounter and warning are the messenger's bounded responsibility; response, endpoint, and ultimate timing remain under the Lord's sovereignty.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates nominal and material branches beneath a verbal imperative and links them to distant context branches. It remains anchored in the focus root ذ ه ب and packet-resolvable coating and deceptive-cloth images. Render it only as a qualified material analogy, never as the imperative's lexical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The root of ٱذْهَبْ includes gilding and gold-washing even though the focus form primarily commands going.

activation_trace.role: Gilding and gold-washing supplies a bright surface that may differ from its substrate.
Coating metal with gold or silver directly echoes the focus gilding branch and activates surface-versus-substance imagery.
A garment that lies by its condition supplies deceptive appearance and connects Pharaoh's denial to the facade analogy.

changed_reading.before: The imperative contributes only physical movement toward Pharaoh.
changed_reading.after: Alongside its primary movement, approaching Pharaoh can be pictured as entering and testing a gold-washed, appearance-driven sovereignty whose surface may lie about its substance.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the rain branch of ذ ه ب and hydraulic branch of ط غ ي beneath ordinary verbal uses. It remains anchored in both focus roots and in packet water, engulfment, and pasture cues. Render it only as an ecological analogy, not as a claim that the focus denotes rain or predicts drowning.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Both focus roots have water-domain branches: ذ ه ب includes rainfall, while ط غ ي includes water that rises and sweeps away.

activation_trace.role: Rainfall supplies a measured arriving-water image for the commissioned going.
Rising water and sweeping force supplies the destructive overflow toward which that arrival is directed.
Engulfment and comprehensiveness sharpens the image of saturation that exceeds a boundary.
The appearance and abundance of water supplies the non-destructive side of hydraulic magnitude.
Pasture supplied by water gives measured flow a life-bearing outcome.

changed_reading.before: Going and transgressing occupy unrelated motion and moral domains.
changed_reading.after: As a contained ecological picture, the commission is a rain-like arrival directed toward destructive overflow, holding open a contrast between water that engulfs and water that sustains pasture.

strongest_changes: The opening motion-to-management chain strengthens the imperative into a governed commission rather than an isolated trip.
The two إلى constructions reverse the mission's shape: Moses goes toward Pharaoh so Pharaoh can be offered a route toward purification and his Lord.
Disclosure, denial, backward turning, striving, gathering, and proclamation make طغى both a purposeful counter-trajectory and a public counter-order.
The generic repetition of طغى with preference, inclination, and restraint converts Pharaoh from an exception into a repeatable human pattern.
The closing endpoint and warning clauses bound the messenger's responsibility to faithful approach and warning rather than control of response or timing.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah sequencing changed the focus from a compact travel command plus moral diagnosis into intersecting models of governed motion, restorative rerouting, counter-mobilization, bounded excess, and limited messenger agency. Split root inventories also preserved material and hydraulic readings that a single dominant gloss would erase.
remaining_uncertainties: The opening kinetic chain may frame the surah's tempo without directly characterizing Moses's going.
The contrast between Pharaoh's claimed height and measured cosmic order is reader-supplied even though its components and sequence are packet-visible.
The gilding and rain analogies are derivationally distant and should remain explicitly exploratory.
